name: firefox-navigation
provenance: Captured 2026-08-24 from a headed Firefox 150.0.2 (Playwright build firefox-1522, launched with headless:false under Xvfb, locale en-US) navigating to a local header-echo server. Verbatim apart from the dropped Host, Connection, Upgrade-Insecure-Requests and Priority headers. Firefox sends no Sec-CH-UA family at all, which is the false-positive trap this fixture guards.
